turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because the account has insufficient credits, so no ads were created.

Here’s the coordinated layout plan for when credits are available:

| Format | Layout |
|---|---|
| **1:1 — Square** | Centered text, with leafy plants framing the lower corners. Address in a bold, full-width cream footer. |
| **9:16 — Vertical** | Stacked text with generous spacing; plants along the sides and bottom. Address on its own prominent cream panel. |
| **16:9 — Landscape** | Text grouped on the left, lush plants on the right. Address in a wide cream footer—not scaled-down square artwork. |

All three will use forest-green type on warm cream, with exactly:
- Fern House
- Weekend Plant Sale
- 20% off all indoor plants
- Saturday & Sunday
- Visit 24 Willow Lane

style.prompt:
Design a polished, exceptionally legible square 1:1 plant-shop sale advertisement. Clean editorial graphic design, warm cream background #F6F2E5, forest green #174B35 typography, subtle sage accents. Lush realistic leafy indoor plants (ferns, monstera, pothos) clustered along lower corners and edges, generous clear cream negative space behind ALL text. Restrained premium neighborhood botanical shop identity. Strong typography hierarchy, modern bold sans-serif, no script, no tiny type. ALL FIVE lines must be clearly readable, including a large bold address near bottom on an unobstructed cream panel. Render ONLY this exact text, with exact spelling and capitalization, no quotation marks and no additional text: 
Fern House
Weekend Plant Sale
20% off all indoor plants
Saturday & Sunday
Visit 24 Willow Lane
Layout: brand centered top; large bold headline upper middle; prominent offer in middle; days below; address large and bold across lower cream panel with ample margins. Keep offer and address easily readable and unoccluded. All five text lines fully inside safe margins, plants never overlap letters. Flat finished ad artwork, not a mockup.
